title: The Hermit of the Gate
text: An old man sits beside the path with a lantern on his knee, as though he has been waiting for this party in particular. He knows your names. He knows the names of your dead. He will answer one question, he says, and only one, and he will not lie.

options.label: Ask him what waits at the end of the road, and trust that he keeps his word.

outcomes.text: He tells you how the master of this place fights, and you believe him. He has watched it for a long time.
He tells you something. It is not true, and he smiles as he says it.

options.label: Thank him, and go on. Some answers cost more than they are worth.

outcomes.text: He nods as if that was the right answer, too, and touches the Leader's brow as they pass. Their head is clearer than it has been in days.

options.label: The Soothsayer asks him what the cards would not say, though they may regret hearing it.

outcomes.text: He answers in the Soothsayer's own voice. It was the right question after all, and the answer is a number: how high their House stands.
He answers, and the answer is about the Soothsayer's own death. They will not say what he told them.
